translation_direction: ja → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Japanese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Sōseki’s plain, measured, inward prose and the formal Meiji narrator are kept; the restraint is kept rather than modernised.
decisions.rationale: The book is its restraint and its self-examination.

decisions.decision: The translation covers the complete novel as printed by Aozora Bunko card 773: three parts, 1331 units.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The soft cloth sash was rendered with a romanisation name; corrected to a soft cloth sash.
The question was inverted; the teacher asks the narrator; corrected.
A sentence about women and the appeal of a woman was mistranslated; restored.
A joke on mixed Tokyo and provincial origins was read as mixed race; corrected.
The causal logic was reversed; corrected to the Japanese cause and effect.
A quoted line of the teacher was read as the narrator’s; corrected.
An inheritance sense of taking one’s share during the father’s lifetime was lost; restored.
Ten or twenty years was rendered as about 120 years; corrected.
The complaint was given to the father; the mother and narrator complain to the uncle; corrected.
The father thanks his wife; the speaker and address were corrected.
The mother’s quoted words were attributed to Mẹ in the third person; corrected.
The central term for ego was given the wrong sense; corrected.
The narrator’s word Tokyo was given to the mother’s deathbed words; corrected.
二里 rendered as two miles while unit 992 gives eight kilometres; made consistent.
The uncle’s house and residence conditions were reversed; corrected.
The sake cup of a wedding was rendered as betrothal; corrected.
The friend’s advice was inverted; corrected.
The tram-line clause was placed in the past against the Japanese; corrected.
No adult man in the house was rendered as no house; corrected.
The group of three including the narrator was misstated; corrected.
A major referent error in part 下; corrected.
K’s audacity was reversed and the narrator’s self-assessment inverted; corrected.
The planned action was changed to going to meet K; corrected.
The inverted who cannot apologise was corrected to the narrator; the apology sense restored.
A referent error in part 下; corrected.
The referent was reversed: the father and brother had neglected K; corrected.
A referent error in part 下; corrected.
The widow of a military man was made the wife of an officer; corrected to a military widow.
The sugi cedar grove was rendered as a tamarisk grove; corrected to Japanese cedar.
The wife as the subject of the thought was misidentified as an older woman; corrected.
The trait was said to be stronger in men when the source says women; corrected.
The Way was made the subject of the sacrifice sentence; corrected to the source sense.
The place name Ryūoka was a misreading of Tatsuoka-chō (たつおか); corrected.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: tiên sinh (narration); bà vợ tiên sinh for the wife
glossary.rationale: The narrator’s name for the teacher, kept throughout; the wife is named by her role.
The narrator’s humble first person and the friend’s initial kept.

glossary.draft_rendering: inner 「」 as ‘ ’ inside an open letter quote “ ”
glossary.rationale: Typographic convention for nested dialogue in the letter.

witness_decision: Selected Aozora Bunko card 773, the text file 773_14560 for Sōseki's Kokoro (1914). The Aozora page does not name the exact printing and the text was not collated with the first serial or book edition.

title_review.rationale: The title is the translation’s chosen Vietnamese title, ‘Tâm’ (heart); the original is Kokoro.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The part heading 上 先生と私, rendered Thượng — Tiên sinh và tôi.
The last unit of the witness: the closing paragraph of the letter.
